source: Zillow Research ZHVI (County, SFR+Condo mid-tier, smoothed SA)
method: salePsf ≈ county ZHVI ÷ 1900 typical finished sf (US counties)
landMethod: Prefer median assessed $/acre from vacant CAD parcels in Houston sample; else proxy (Houston) or unavailable elsewhere. Not sales comps.
disclaimer: Home $/sf from public ZHVI research (not MLS). Land $/acre from CAD sample or proxies where available. Assessor values ≠ list prices. Optional RentCast when API key set.
